title: Long-Horizon Multi-Object Rearrangement via Distilled Tree Search over Continuous Actions
comment: Accepted at CoRL 2026 (Oral). Project page: this https URL
summary: Despite recent advances in policy learning, long-horizon manipulation remains difficult because learned policies must avoid compounding errors while preserving future feasibility. While search-based planning can explicitly reason over such future consequences, it quickly becomes expensive in high-dimensional continuous action spaces. This raises a central question: how can long-horizon reasoning from search be transferred into policies in continuous action spaces? To this end, we propose DISCO: Distilled Tree Search over Continuous Actions. DISCO uses progressive-widening MCTS in physics simulation to generate long-horizon plans. During search, a learned policy proposes continuous actions, while a learned value function scores actions by their expected progress toward task completion. Using GPU-parallelized simulation, DISCO periodically distills MCTS-generated plans into the policy-value model, improving the action proposals and value estimates used in subsequent searches. Finally, the learned policy-value model can be directly deployed without the need for simulator-based search at test time. Across simulated and real-world rearrangement tasks, DISCO outperforms behavior cloning, reinforcement learning, and search-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出DISCO：在物理仿真中用渐进加宽MCTS生成连续动作长程规划，由策略网络提议动作、价值网络评估任务完成进度，并周期性将搜索结果蒸馏回策略-价值模型；测试时无需仿真搜索，可直接部署策略。
AI.motivation: 长程操作任务中，学习型策略存在误差累积、难以保证未来可行性；基于搜索的规划虽能显式推理未来后果，但在高维连续动作空间中开销过大。核心问题：如何把搜索的长程推理能力迁移到连续动作空间的策略中。
AI.method: 渐进加宽MCTS + 物理仿真生成长程计划；学习策略提供连续动作提议，学习价值函数按预期任务进度打分；GPU并行仿真加速；周期性将MCTS计划蒸馏到策略-价值模型，迭代提升提议与价值估计质量；最终策略-价值模型可脱离仿真器直接部署。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实世界的重排（rearrangement）任务上，DISCO优于行为克隆、强化学习及基于搜索的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将搜索式长程推理通过迭代蒸馏注入连续动作策略是可行且有效的，可在推理时摆脱仿真搜索开销，并在真实机器人任务上取得优势。

title: Do We Need Learned Targets? Classical Gradients as Supervision for 2D Gaussian Initialization
summary: Learning-based Gaussian image initializers can require costly supervision obtained by per-image optimization. We investigate whether the Pseudo-PPM targets used by Instant GaussianImage can be replaced by classical image gradients. Our framework uses normalized Sobel maps in two tracks. A training-free analytic initializer combines probability boosting, parallel grid-based sampling, and geometric processing, producing initial parameters in 0.32 seconds on average. A neural initializer is trained on DIV2K with online Sobel supervision, which removes offline target optimization and allows training to scale to 10,000 LSDIR images without additional preprocessing. Both tracks achieve competitive long-budget reconstruction on Kodak and DIV2K. Under domain shift, the DIV2K-trained neural initializer surpasses Instant-GI on Manga109 from 500 fitting iterations onward (by 1.40 dB at 5K iterations), and training on LSDIR increases this margin to 1.85 dB. On Kvasir-SEG, the training-free analytic initializer exceeds Instant-GI at every reported budget. A controlled pipeline-time comparison yields an estimated $4.9\times$ reduction for DIV2K. These results establish inexpensive analytic targets as a practical alternative to optimization-derived supervision for scalable Gaussian initialization.

AI.tldr: 用归一化 Sobel 梯度替代 Instant GaussianImage 中逐图优化的 Pseudo-PPM 目标，提出免训练解析初始化器与 Sobel 在线监督的神经初始化器，实现快速、可扩展的高斯图像初始化。
AI.motivation: 基于学习的 Gaussian image 初始化依赖逐图优化得到的有监督信号，成本高且难以扩展到大规模数据；作者探究经典图像梯度能否替代 Pseudo-PPM 目标。
AI.method: 两条技术路线均使用归一化 Sobel 图：(1) 免训练解析初始化器，结合概率增强、并行网格采样与几何处理；(2) 神经初始化器，在 DIV2K 上用在线 Sobel 监督训练，去除离线目标优化，可直接扩展到 1 万张 LSDIR 图像。
AI.result: 解析初始化平均 0.32 秒生成初始参数；两路在 Kodak、DIV2K 上报长期预算重建性能具竞争力；域偏移下 DIV2K 训练的网络在 Manga109 上从 500 次拟合迭代起超过 Instant-GI（5K 迭代 +1.40 dB），用 LSDIR 训练提升至 1.85 dB；Kvasir-SEG 上解析法在所有预算均优于 Instant-GI；端到端耗时估计降低 4.9 倍（DIV2K）。
AI.conclusion: 廉价解析梯度目标可作为优化派生监督的实用替代方案，支撑可扩展的高斯初始化。

title: Hihaze: One-Step Diffusion for High-Resolution Real-World Image Dehazing
comment: Code is available at: this https URL
summary: Diffusion models have recently achieved encouraging results in real-world image dehazing. However, restoring high-resolution images remains challenging due to spatially non-uniform haze and inconsistent predictions across local patches. To address these issues, we propose Hihaze, a one-step diffusion framework for high-resolution real-world dehazing. Hihaze adopts two haze-aware modulation modules: attentive skip compensation (ASC) and a spatial degradation adapter (SDA). ASC selectively transfers reliable encoder information to the variational autoencoder (VAE) decoder, preserving structural details while suppressing haze-degraded features. SDA extracts multi-scale spatial degradation representations and injects them into the U-Net to guide restoration according to local haze variations. Furthermore, we design a training-free global-guided patch fusion (GPF) method. It uses a global prediction to align patch appearance and downweight unreliable predictions, followed by structure-guided detail compensation. Notably, this training-free design also makes GPF a plug-and-play module for other dehazing models. Experiments across four real-world benchmarks show that Hihaze surpasses state-of-the-art approaches in both visual quality and inference speed. Specifically, it delivers PSNR improvements of 3.62~dB on Dense-Haze and 3.69~dB on NH-HAZE compared with the strongest baselines. Code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: Hihaze是一个单步扩散框架，用于高分辨率真实场景去雾，通过ASC与SDA两个雾感知调制模块以及免训练的全局引导块融合（GPF）解决空间非均匀雾和块间预测不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 真实场景去雾中，空间非均匀的雾分布与局部块预测不一致导致高分辨率图像恢复困难；同时多步扩散推理速度慢。
AI.method: 基于单步扩散的一体化框架：attentive skip compensation (ASC) 选择性把编码器可靠信息传给VAE解码器以保留结构细节、抑制雾退化特征；spatial degradation adapter (SDA) 提取多尺度空间退化表示并注入U-Net以按局部雾变化引导恢复；免训练 global-guided patch fusion (GPF) 用全局预测对齐块外观、降低不可靠预测权重，再做结构引导的细节补偿，可插拔用于其他去雾模型。
AI.result: 在四个真实去雾基准上，视觉质量与推理速度均优于SOTA；Dense-Haze上PSNR提升约3.62 dB、NH-HAZE上约3.69 dB。
AI.conclusion: 面向高分辨率真实去雾的单步扩散方案在精度与效率上同时受益，GPF的免训练设计具备较好的通用迁移性。

title: OV-PEAR: Observation-Verified Pose-Scale Estimation and Reconstruction for Unknown Industrial Manipulation Objects
summary: Fine industrial robotic manipulation requires 6D pose, scale, and an operation-ready 3D model. Existing industrial pose estimation relies on CAD models, object-specific training data, or stable workcells, limiting use with unseen objects; zero-shot methods suffer from single-view occlusion, generative bias, and scale uncertainty. We present OV-PEAR, an observation-verified framework for 3D reconstruction and pose-scale estimation of unknown industrial objects. Its three-stage object-centric pipeline: (1) segments RGB-D instances and generates object-level 3D hypotheses; (2) anchors them to the robot frame via appearance-aware view retrieval, explicit scale search, and visibility-sensitive registration; (3) back-projects multi-view RGB-D evidence into the object-canonical frame to verify voxel occupancy, suppress hallucinations, and produce reusable trusted object models. On BOP-Industrial, OV-PEAR achieves 0.657 average AR and improves pose and voxel-level geometric consistency in real scenes; real-robot connector assembly reaches 99.67% grasp and 84.00% assembly success. The model library and pose-scale log enable short-term object-level state maintenance at 0.02 ms/frame.

AI.tldr: OV-PEAR：面向未知工业物体的零样本6D位姿-尺度估计与可信3D重建框架，通过“分割+生成假设→机器人坐标系锚定→多视角占据验证”三阶段流水线抑制生成幻觉，在BOP-Industrial取得0.657 AR，并支撑真机连接器装配（抓取99.67%/装配84.00%）。
AI.motivation: 工业6D位姿估计依赖CAD模型、物体专属训练数据或稳定工位，难以处理未见物体；零样本生成式方法存在单视图遮挡、生成偏差与尺度不确定三大痛点，而精细操作同时需要位姿、尺度与可直接操作的3D模型。
AI.method: 三阶段物体中心流水线：(1) RGB-D实例分割+物体级3D假设生成；(2) 借外观感知视图检索、显式尺度搜索与可见性敏感配准将假设锚定至机器人坐标系；(3) 将多视角RGB-D证据反投影至物体规范坐标系，进行体素占据验证，抑制幻觉并产出可复用可信模型；同时维护模型库与位姿-尺度日志实现物体级状态短时维护（0.02 ms/帧）。
AI.result: BOP-Industrial上平均AR 0.657；真实场景中位姿与体素级几何一致性提升；真机连接器装配达99.67%抓取成功率与84.00%装配成功率；状态维护开销仅0.02 ms/帧。
AI.conclusion: 以“观测验证”取代纯生成先验，可有效抑制零样本重建幻觉并获得尺度可靠、可复用的物体模型，打通从感知到真机装配的闭环，适合工业未知物体少样本/零样本操作场景。

title: SWIFT: Self-guided Weak-to-strong dIFfusion models via Target extrapolation
summary: Training high-quality diffusion models is computationally expensive, and inference-time guidance often adds further sampling cost. In this work, we introduce Swift, a simple yet effective self-guided training method that uses a frozen weak denoiser to improve a stronger model without adding inference overhead. For each noisy input, Swift extrapolates the clean regression target away from the weak denoiser's prediction, amplifying components that remain underfit. The weak guide can be an early training checkpoint, requires no backpropagation during main-model training, and is discarded afterward. The resulting model retains the original sampler and supports both conditional and unconditional generation without label dropout or an unconditional branch. We explain this mechanism through a spectral analysis of finite-time population gradient flow in an RKHS. With an early-stopped weak guide, we prove that a nonempty range of extrapolation strengths yields strictly lower posterior-mean error than matched standard training, despite shifting the regression target away from the posterior mean. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-256 demonstrate improvements across model scales and representations. In one ImageNet-256 configuration, Swift surpasses the baseline's best FID using roughly half the total training compute, including guide preparation and training overhead. On RAEv2, it achieves FID 1.15 without inference-time guidance and 0.99 with guidance. These results establish target extrapolation as an effective approach to weak-to-strong diffusion training with efficient single-model inference.

AI.tldr: Swift提出一种自引导扩散训练方法：用冻结的"弱去噪器"（早期checkpoint）对干净回归目标做外推，放大欠拟合分量以训练更强模型，且不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 高质量扩散模型训练代价高昂，推理期引导又额外增加采样成本；希望在不引入推理开销、不改变采样器的前提下提升训练效率与生成质量。
AI.method: 对每个噪声输入，将干净回归目标朝远离弱去噪器预测的方向外推；弱引导者为早期训练checkpoint，主模型训练中无需反传，训练后丢弃。保持原采样器，支持条件/无条件生成，无需label dropout。并用RKHS中有限时间群体梯度流的谱分析给出理论解释。
AI.result: 理论上证明在早停弱引导下存在非空外推强度区间，使后验均值误差严格低于匹配的标准训练；CIFAR-10与ImageNet-256上跨模型规模与表征均有提升；ImageNet-256某配置以约一半总训练算力超过基线最佳FID；RAEv2上无引导FID 1.15、有引导0.99。
AI.conclusion: 目标外推是一种有效的"弱到强"扩散训练范式，实现高效的单模型推理。

title: Auditing Semantic and Relational Reliability in Open-Vocabulary Human-Object Interaction Evaluation
summary: Open-vocabulary human-object interaction detectors describe interactions in free text, and this creates a problem for evaluation. Category scoring rejects valid paraphrases, while semantic similarity scoring can reward predictions that name the wrong action or reverse the roles of the participants. We present a diagnostic protocol that holds every prediction fixed and scores it under five views, namely official category evaluation, an identity control, lexical normalization, graded semantic credit, and strict propositional equivalence. Comparing these views separates the effect of the matching engine from the effect of semantic credit. The protocol pairs controlled transformations that preserve or break meaning with a blinded audit of natural predictions, and we derive consistency checks that link mean credit, invalid acceptance, and transformation counts. Applied to six systems on HICO-DET, the views disagree on which system leads. GEN-VLKT leads under official evaluation, SL-HOI leads under SHOE, and GEN-VLKT leads again under strict equivalence. Semantic gains range from 1.6 to 20.3 mAP, and AgentHOI keeps less than half of its gain once equivalence is enforced. We recommend that semantic scores be reported together with relational validity and paired uncertainty, so that recovered credit is not read as better interaction understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出一个诊断式评估协议：固定所有预测，用五个视角（官方类别评测、身份对照、词法归一、分级语义得分、严格命题等价）分别打分，以分离匹配引擎效应与语义宽容效应。
AI.motivation: 开放词表HOI检测器用自由文本描述交互，导致评测困境：类别匹配会拒绝有效同义改写，语义相似度匹配又会奖励错误动作或主客体角色颠倒的预测，两类评测都无法区分"语言宽容"与"真实交互理解"。
AI.method: 诊断协议：保持预测不变，在五种评测视角下打分；配对"保义/破义"控制变换与对自然预测的盲审；推导连接平均得分、非法接受率与变换计数的自洽性校验；在HICO-DET上对六个系统实证。
AI.result: 各视角给出的领先系统不一致：GEN-VLKT在官方评测与严格等价下领先，SL-HOI在SHOE下领先；语义增益为1.6–20.3 mAP，AgentHOI在施加命题等价约束后仅保留不到一半的增益。
AI.conclusion: 语义得分必须与关系有效性和配对不确定度一并报告，避免把"收回的语言得分"误读为更好的交互理解；该协议可作为开放词表HOI评测的标准诊断层。

title: ActionRoPE: action as coordinates for spatially consistent control in planar-camera game world models
summary: Game world models have made rapid progress toward real-time interactive generation. Yet action control is still predominantly implemented as feature conditioning, leaving the model to learn from training data how each action should move the visual world. This formulation is poorly matched to a broad class of planar-camera worlds, such as top-down and isometric games. In these worlds, player motion induces a geometrically well-defined planar camera displacement. We observe that the key to spatially consistent control in such worlds is to represent the effect of each action directly in world coordinates. To this end, we introduce ActionRoPE, a parameter-free action interface that converts action-driven camera displacement into world-coordinate rotary positions. As a result, tokens corresponding to the same world location retain the same positional address across time. These world coordinates further expose a spatial asymmetry in generation: regions covered by the initial observation are geometrically known, while newly revealed regions remain to be synthesized. We therefore propose Coordinate-Conditioned Noise Scheduling (CNS), which assigns token-wise denoising schedules according to this known-new structure. It allows observed regions to stabilize earlier, while new content is generated with reference to them. Compared with four representative action-conditioning mechanisms, our approach follows the commanded motion more faithfully and reduces the revisit drift by 66% over the strongest baseline. The same interface transfers across video backbones from 1.3B to 33B parameters and to out-of-distribution scenes. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 ActionRoPE 参数化无关的动作接口，将动作驱动的平面相机位移编码为世界坐标旋转位置，配合坐标条件噪声调度 CNS，实现俯视/等距游戏世界模型中几何一致的动作控制，回访漂移较最强基线降低66%。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏世界模型仍以特征条件化方式注入动作，依赖数据隐式学习动作对视觉世界的影响，难以契合俯视/等距等平面相机世界中几何上明确、且相机真实位姿常可从引擎获取的场景。
AI.method: ActionRoPE：无参数的 action interface，把动作引起的相机位移转换为世界坐标下的 rotary position（对 token 施加世界坐标 RoPE），使同一世界位置的 token 跨时间保持相同位置地址；CNS：依据"初始观测覆盖的已知区域 vs 新揭示区域"的空间非对称性，对 token 分配逐 token 去噪日程，让已知区域先收敛、新内容以其为参照生成。
AI.result: 与四种代表性动作条件化机制对比，更忠实地跟随指令运动，回访漂移降低66%；接口可跨 1.3B–33B 参数量的多种视频骨干迁移，并可泛化到分布外场景。
AI.conclusion: 将动作效果直接表示在世界坐标中，是平面相机类世界模型实现空间一致控制的关键；ActionRoPE 与 CNS 无需参数、即插即用、可跨骨干与场景迁移，为可交互世界模型提供了简洁有效的几何对齐控制范式。

title: AeroIntent: A Synchronized Multimodal Benchmark for UAV Mission Intent Recognition
summary: Reliable recognition of mission-level UAV intent from multimodal observations is essential for low-altitude airspace surveillance and security. Existing multimodal UAV datasets primarily support detection, tracking, and localization, leaving limited support for evaluating mission-intent recognition across held-out trajectory programs and incomplete radar histories. We introduce AeroIntent, a simulation-based benchmark comprising 990 synchronized multimodal sequences generated by 22 trajectory programs across five mission intents. The benchmark provides radar, RGB, infrared, and depth observations, together with program-disjoint, radar-gap, and observation-prefix evaluation protocols. Building on this benchmark, we propose AeroMIR, a structured Multimodal Intent Reasoner that integrates radar trajectories, derived behavioral features, selected visual evidence, and task knowledge for candidate-based UAV intent recognition. Under a strict program-disjoint protocol evaluating unseen tactical realizations, AeroMIR achieves a mean accuracy of 71.56% and a mean Macro-F1 of 69.84% across three seeds, outperforming the strongest trajectory-only baseline by 7.79 Macro-F1 points and a conventional radar-RGB late-fusion baseline by 19.32 points. AeroMIR also demonstrates strong performance under controlled radar gaps and early intent recognition settings. AeroIntent and AeroMIR provide a reproducible foundation for multimodal UAV intent recognition. The benchmark is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 AeroIntent 仿真多模态无人机意图识别基准（990 条雷达/RGB/红外/深度序列，5 类任务意图、22 个轨迹程序）与 AeroMIR 结构化多模态意图推理器，在程序不相交协议下达到 71.56% 准确率、69.84% Macro-F1。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机多模态数据集主要服务于检测、跟踪与定位，缺乏对"任务级意图识别"的评测支持，尤其在未见轨迹程序泛化与雷达历史缺失场景下缺少统一协议。
AI.method: 构建基于仿真的同步多模态基准 AeroIntent，提供程序不相交、雷达缺失、观测前缀三种评测协议；提出 AeroMIR，融合雷达轨迹、派生行为特征、筛选后的视觉证据与任务知识，进行候选式意图推理。
AI.result: 程序不相交协议下三随机种子平均准确率 71.56%、Macro-F1 69.84%，分别超出最强纯轨迹基线 7.79 个点、常规雷达-RGB 后融合基线 19.32 个点；在雷达间隙与早期意图识别设定下亦表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: AeroIntent 与 AeroMIR 为多模态无人机意图识别提供了可复现的评测基础与结构化推理范式，但证据为纯仿真、限定五类意图，真实部署验证有限。

title: Vision-Language-Delta-Action: Learning Compact Deltas as Actionable Transition Interfaces for Robotic Manipulation
comment: 37 pages, including appendix. Code framework: this https URL
summary: Robotic manipulation is not merely observation-to-action generation, but the realization of task-specified state changes in the physical world. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) methods directly learn observation-to-action mappings, imposing a substantial learning burden due to the gap between semantic understanding and action execution. Although world-action models (WAMs) improve control through future prediction, modeling complete future states wastes capacity on static appearance and action-irrelevant changes. We propose Vision-Language-Delta-Action (VLDA), a paradigm that reformulates full future prediction as compact actionable transition modeling. Its core is a compact Delta variable that captures latent world-state changes, serving as an interface between vision-language understanding and action generation. VLDA learns Delta through a unified objective composed of the Local Transition Filter (LT-Filter) and Global Transition Anchor (GT-Anchor). LT-Filter captures task-relevant manipulation-centric changes while suppressing static reconstruction biases. GT-Anchor provides coarse future-level regularization to preserve the overall direction of state changes. Delta-Driven Action Refinement (DDAR) further grounds Delta in the action manifold and injects it as a structured seed to guide action denoising. We implement VLDA within LoongForge, an open-source training framework for large-scale foundation and embodied models, using its modular and distributed infrastructure for unified two-stage optimization. Experiments show that VLDA improves long-horizon consistency, robustness, and generalization, validating actionable Delta as an alternative to direct action prediction and full future-state modeling.

AI.tldr: VLDA将"预测完整未来帧"重构为"预测紧凑的Delta世界状态变化量"，以LT-Filter+GT-Anchor统一目标学习Delta，再由DDAR将其注入动作去噪，作为视觉语言理解与动作生成之间的接口。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA直接从观测学动作映射，语义理解与动作执行之间存在鸿沟、学习负担重；WAM虽通过未来预测改善控制，但建模完整未来状态会把容量浪费在静态外观与动作无关变化上。
AI.method: 提出VLDA范式：用紧凑Delta变量刻画潜在世界状态变化。统一训练目标由两部分构成——Local Transition Filter（LT-Filter）提取任务相关的操作中心变化并抑制静态重建偏差；Global Transition Anchor（GT-Anchor）提供粗粒度未来级正则以保持状态变化整体方向。Delta-Driven Action Refinement（DDAR）将Delta投射到动作流形上，作为结构化种子引导动作扩散去噪。在开源框架LoongForge上以模块化分布式基础设施完成两阶段统一优化。
AI.result: 实验显示VLDA在长程一致性、鲁棒性和泛化性上均有提升，验证可操作Delta可作为直接动作预测与完整未来状态建模的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 以"可操作状态变化"而非"完整未来预测"为中心的表征是VLA/WAM之间的有效折中，Delta可作为视觉语言到动作的中间接口。

title: Rethinking Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting: A Few-Shot Learning Perspective on Overfitting Prevention
comment: 5 pages, 5 figures. First-place solution in the sparse-view track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 Volumetric Video Challenge
summary: Sparse-view novel view synthesis (NVS) is essential for AR/VR and real-time communication applications, yet remains challenging when reconstructing 3D scenes from limited viewpoints. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) excels in dense-view scenarios, it suffers from overfitting and geometry degradation under sparse inputs. Current approaches often tackle these problems from a local perspective, addressing either data quality or training regularization individually, lacking a unified and interpretable framework for systematic improvement. We introduce a new perspective that reframes sparse-view 3DGS from a few-shot learning viewpoint, treating each Gaussian primitive as a neuron and leveraging deep learning regularization techniques. Under this unified framework, our approach generates more effective supervision from scarce observations through two strategies: (1) data-related supervision enrichment via optical flow-guided pseudo-view synthesis and joint camera-scene optimization; and (2) training-time regularization via motion-aware dropout and early stopping, which suppress overfitting while preserving dynamic-scene stability. Extensive experiments on the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 volumetric video challenge sparse-view dataset demonstrate significant improvements over state-of-the-art optimization-based and feed-forward baselines. Our system won first place in the sparse-view track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 challenge.

AI.tldr: 将稀疏视角3DGS重解释为少样本学习问题，把每个高斯基元视为神经元，用深度学习正则化手段从数据增强与训练时正则两方面系统抑制过拟合，获SIGGRAPH Asia 2025稀疏视角赛道第一。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角NVS对AR/VR与实时通信重要，但3DGS在稀疏输入下易过拟合、几何退化；现有方法多从局部角度分别处理数据质量或训练正则，缺少统一且可解释的系统性框架。
AI.method: 提出"少样本学习"统一视角：高斯基元=神经元。(1) 数据侧监督增强：光流引导的伪视角合成 + 相机-场景联合优化；(2) 训练侧正则：运动感知dropout与早停，抑制过拟合同时保持动态场景稳定。
AI.result: 在SIGGRAPH Asia 2025体积视频挑战赛稀疏视角数据集上显著优于SOTA优化类与前馈类基线，系统获该赛道第一名。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏3DGS的改进可借少样本学习框架统一组织数据增强与正则化策略，形成可解释的系统性方案；动态场景（体积视频）下的稀疏重建是其主要验证场景。

title: Out-of-Distribution Detection in Continual Learning
comment: Accepted at the 40th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Out-of-distribution detection in continual learning (OOD-CL) is highly challenging, as it requires (i) learning a sequence of tasks without catastrophic forgetting, and (ii) identifying unknown samples (OOD) without access to known (in-distribution (ID)) data from past tasks, where standard confidence-based OOD scores tend to degrade. Existing methods largely rely on a rehearsal buffer of past data or assume closed-world settings, limiting their scalability and reliability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel OOD detection framework for rehearsal-free continual learning, inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), which mitigate catastrophic forgetting via their inherent local neuroplasticity. To better leverage KAN in OOD-CL, we introduce a task-adaptive classifier architecture, TA-KAN, which mitigates recency bias and enhances ID--OOD separability through task-specific control of activation locality. Furthermore, we propose a geometry-guided OOD score that complements TA-KAN classifier confidence without relying on past ID data. Our method significantly improves OOD detection while maintaining strong ID classification performance, achieving state-of-the-art results in OOD-CL.

AI.tldr: 提出面向无回放持续学习的OOD检测框架TA-KAN，基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络固有的局部神经可塑性缓解灾难性遗忘，并通过任务自适应控制激活局部性提升ID-OOD可分性，配合不依赖历史ID数据的几何引导OOD评分，达到OOD-CL的SOTA。
AI.motivation: 持续学习中的OOD检测需同时解决两个矛盾：一是任务序列学习中不能灾难性遗忘，二是在无法访问过去任务ID数据时识别未知样本，此时基于置信度的OOD分数会退化。现有方法多依赖历史数据回放缓冲或闭世界假设，可扩展性与可靠性不足。
AI.method: 以KAN的局部神经可塑性作为抗遗忘机制，构建任务自适应分类器架构TA-KAN，对激活局部性进行任务级控制以缓解新近偏置、增强ID–OOD可分性；并设计一种几何引导的OOD评分，与TA-KAN置信度互补，无需依赖过往ID数据。
AI.result: 在保持较强ID分类性能的同时显著提升OOD检测效果，在OOD-CL设定下取得SOTA结果（摘要未给出具体数据集与数值）。
AI.conclusion: 将KAN的局部可塑性引入无回放持续学习，可在不存储历史数据的前提下兼顾抗遗忘与开放世界OOD检测，为无回放OOD-CL提供了可扩展方案。

title: Multi-scale Fusion of Fast Vision Mamba and Foundation Model Features for Patch-Level Gleason Grading in Computational Pathology
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures and 4 tables (including supplementary), Accepted to COMPAYL workshop MICCAI 2026, Comments are welcome!
summary: Automated Gleason grading of prostate whole slide images (WSIs) enables faster and more consistent cancer risk stratification. However, it remains a challenging task due to the subtle morphological differences between grades, the severe class imbalance arising from rare patterns, and the diagnostic features that span multiple spatial scales. Pathology foundation models (FMs) extract strong patch representations but often operate at a single-scale, which limits spatial context and disproportionately affects classes that depend on broader context. The challenge of fusing multiple scales and complementary models, with minimal data and computational resources, remains unresolved. We propose a multi-scale classifier built on state-space models. Our method combines two complementary feature sources: a frozen foundation model, and a lightweight FastVim, pre-trained on ImageNet and distilled from the foundation model, that reads the raw image crops. At each scale, a Mamba model encodes the features from both sources with linear-time spatial context, and a jointly trained head fuses the encoded representations into one prediction. On the PANDA dataset, our method reaches macro F1 of 0.894 and Gleason 5 F1 of 0.802 under 5-fold cross-validation, a 12% and 21% relative improvement over the best single-scale model. A controlled study over 5 foundation models, 5 base classifiers and 3 scales confirms that the gain holds across encoders, with larger improvements observed at smaller scales.

AI.tldr: 提出基于状态空间模型(Mamba)的多尺度前列腺WSI Gleason分级分类器，融合冻结病理基础模型特征与蒸馏的轻量FastVim特征，在PANDA上取得macro-F1 0.894、Gleason 5 F1 0.802。
AI.motivation: Gleason自动分级面临类间形态差异细微、稀有模式导致严重类别不平衡、诊断特征跨多个空间尺度等挑战；病理基础模型多为单尺度推理，缺乏全局上下文，影响依赖大范围上下文的类别；在数据与算力有限条件下多尺度与互补模型融合仍未被解决。
AI.method: 双特征源：冻结的病理基础模型 + 基于ImageNet预训练并由基础模型蒸馏的轻量FastVim读取原始图像块；每个尺度上用Mamba编码双源特征的线性时间复杂度空间上下文，共享训练头将各尺度编码表示融合为单一预测；PANDA数据集5折交叉验证，并对5个基础模型、5个基分类器、3个尺度做受控消融。
AI.result: PANDA上5折交叉验证macro F1=0.894，Gleason 5 F1=0.802，相对最优单尺度模型分别提升12%与21%；受控实验显示增益在各类编码器上稳定成立，尺度越小提升越明显。
AI.conclusion: 以状态空间模型实现线性复杂度的多尺度上下文编码与互补特征融合，是低算力条件下提升病理WSI分级性能的有效且可迁移方案。

title: LEAP: Accelerating ODE-based Diffusion Sampling with Optimal Linear Leaps
summary: Diffusion models primarily rely on general-purpose ODE-based numerical methods for training-free accelerated sampling, but performance degrades with coarse time discretization. In this paper, we propose optimal linear leaps (LEAP), a specialized method grounded in theoretical and empirical investigations of sampling trajectory geometry. Built upon low-dimensionality and cross-trajectory consistency, LEAP formulates a supervised least-squares optimization problem within the local trajectory subspace, achieving a precise approximation of future states without model evaluations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LEAP outperforms previous methods across diverse modalities, including text-to-image (Stable Diffusion 3.5, FLUX.1-dev) and image-to-3D (TRELLIS.2) generation. Furthermore, LEAP can be seamlessly integrated into existing solver-based methods, offering a plug-and-play enhancement for modern diffusion models. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: LEAP：基于采样轨迹几何（低维性与跨轨迹一致性）的扩散模型免训练加速采样方法，在局部轨迹子空间做最小二乘优化直接预测未来状态，替代通用ODE数值求解器。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型免训练加速采样普遍依赖通用ODE数值求解器，粗时间离散下误差显著、性能退化；需要针对采样轨迹几何特性定制的求解方案。
AI.method: 从理论与实证角度分析采样轨迹几何，利用轨迹低维性与跨轨迹一致性，将轨迹建模为局部低维子空间，构造监督式最小二乘优化问题，在子空间内线性外推获得未来状态的高精度近似，无需额外模型评估（无函数求值），并可即插即用地嵌入现有求解器。
AI.result: 在多种模态上超越已有免训练加速方法：文本到图像（Stable Diffusion 3.5、FLUX.1-dev）与图像到3D（TRELLIS.2）；与现有基于求解器的方法组合后仍有持续增益。
AI.conclusion: 面向扩散/流匹配采样的通用加速器，强调几何驱动的无模型少步采样，适用面广但未涉及机器人策略、动作生成或物理交互验证。

title: SAPO: Self-Supervised Attention Policy Optimization for Improving Temporal Video Grounding in Vision-Language Models
summary: Video vision-language models (VLMs) have strong semantic understanding, yet remain unreliable at precise temporal grounding. Existing gains from explicitly aligning video frames with absolute time suggest that VLMs may already encode accurate temporal locations internally but lose precision when expressing them as timestamps. Our analysis across four VLMs and two grounding datasets confirms this hypothesis: attention intervals outperform predicted intervals on approximately 66% of valid examples. We term this discrepancy the temporal generation gap. Because precise temporal annotations are expensive, this finding motivates closing the gap to improve temporal grounding using only unlabeled video-query pairs. We propose Self-Supervised Attention Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses internal temporal attention as self-supervision for Group Relative Policy Optimization and applies a ground-truth-free criterion to select high-value samples. SAPO consistently improves temporal grounding across multiple datasets and models spanning weak to strong initial grounding ability. Relative mIoU gains reach 33.7% on Qwen2.5-VL-3B and 5.4% on the strong Time-R1-7B. The improvements transfer across datasets while preserving general video understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出"时序生成差距"概念并给出SAPO：用模型内部时序注意力作为自监督信号驱动GRPO，无需时间标注即提升视频VLM时序定位精度。
AI.motivation: 视频VLM语义理解强但时间戳预测不准；分析发现其内部注意力区间已接近真值（约66%样本优于预测区间），差距出现在"注意力→时间戳"的表达阶段，而精确时序标注昂贵，故希望无标注地缩小该差距。
AI.method: 1) 在4个VLM、2个定位数据集上对比注意力区间与预测区间的IoU，量化temporal generation gap；2) SAPO：以内部时序注意力构造自监督奖励，结合Group Relative Policy Optimization做策略优化；3) 用无真值准则（如奖励一致性/置信度）筛选高价值无标注video-query样本。
AI.result: 多数据集多模型一致提升：Qwen2.5-VL-3B相对mIoU +33.7%，强基线Time-R1-7B +5.4%；跨数据集可迁移，且保留通用视频理解能力。
AI.conclusion: 内部时序注意力是廉价且有效的自监督信号，可将VLM潜在的时间定位知识显式化为时间戳；纯无标注RL式微调即可稳定提升时序grounding并具泛化性。

title: MIRA: A Multimodal Illustrated Deep Research Agent for Controllable Reports
summary: Deep research agents are increasingly capable of searching the open web and synthesizing evidence, yet they remain poorly suited to controllable report generation in multimodal deep research. This task requires agents to handle interleaved textual and visual inputs, gather multimodal evidence through multi-step web search, and deliver comprehensive illustrated reports under user-specified requirements. Existing systems face two limitations. During reasoning, they often underuse images discovered along the search trajectory; during generation, they tend to produce fixed-form answers with limited control over report granularity, multimodal composition, and evidence grounding. We introduce MIRA, a Multimodal Illustrated Deep Research Agent for controllable reports. MIRA integrates textual and visual evidence throughout research and writing. At its core, MIRA-Harness translates user requirements into generation contracts and connects four stages: evidence collection, report submission, feedback-driven revision, and final delivery. Building on this harness, MIRA-Data constructs high-quality multi-hop multimodal research trajectories, and we post-train foundation models to operate within the workflow. Using Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MIRA achieves state-of-the-art performance among open agents on 7 representative, established multimodal-search and deep-research-agent benchmarks, while producing user-aligned illustrated reports with traceable textual and visual evidence.

AI.tldr: MIRA：面向可控多模态图文报告生成的多模态深度研究智能体，含MIRA-Harness（需求→生成契约+四阶段工作流）与MIRA-Data（多跳多模态轨迹），并在7个基准上SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究智能体在推理中常忽略搜索轨迹中发现的图像，生成时形式固定、对报告粒度/多模态构成/证据溯源缺乏控制，难以产出符合用户要求的多模态图解报告。
AI.method: 提出MIRA：MIRA-Harness将用户需求转化为生成契约，串联证据收集、报告提交、反馈驱动修订、最终交付四阶段；MIRA-Data构造高质量多跳多模态研究轨迹，并在该工作流上后训练基础模型（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B）。
AI.result: 在7个代表性多模态检索与深度研究智能体基准上取得开源智能体中的SOTA，并生成与用户需求对齐、文本与视觉证据可溯源的图解报告。
AI.conclusion: 将文本与视觉证据贯穿研究与写作全程、并以契约化工作流约束生成，是提升深度研究报告可控性与证据基础的有效路径。

title: CondenseVLA: Learnable History Condensation for Efficient Multi-Frame VLA
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 39 pages, including supplementary material and the NeurIPS paper checklist. Project page: this https URL
summary: Robot manipulation often depends on short-term cues - such as brief contacts, temporary occlusions, and intermediate object states - that are ambiguous in a single frame and can only be resolved by integrating observations over time. However, injecting historical information solely by enlarging the history window is computationally costly and frequently yields limited gains due to substantial redundancy and task-agnostic, inflexible sampling of observations. We propose CondenseVLA, a multi-frame VLA policy with a learnable decoder-side history condensation module for using short-term visual context in action decoding. Given a sequence of cached per-frame features from the VLM backbone, CondenseVLA distills observation history into a fixed set of slot tokens using learnable queries and multi-head cross-attention. Simple auxiliary regularization penalizes overlap among slot attention maps and decorrelates slot embeddings, encouraging complementary attention and reducing slot redundancy. Across the evaluated tasks, CondenseVLA improves Simpler-WidowX success from 58.7% to 69.8% (+11.1 percentage points), achieves 97.2% on LIBERO, and reaches 52.8% on real-world tasks. It achieves 21.6% success on memory-dependent RMBench tasks. These results support selective condensation of bounded recent visual evidence for action decoding, while harder multi-observation tasks expose the limits of a finite history window. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: CondenseVLA：在解码端用可学习slot查询+多头交叉注意力将VLM缓存的逐帧特征蒸馏为固定数量的历史token，并加正则鼓励注意力互补，从而高效利用短期视觉上下文。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作依赖短时线索（短暂接触、临时遮挡、中间物体状态），单帧歧义，需时间整合；但简单扩大历史窗口计算昂贵，且因冗余与任务无关的固定采样收益有限。
AI.method: 多帧VLA策略，VLM主干输出逐帧缓存特征；解码端历史压缩模块用可学习query与多头交叉注意力聚合为固定集合slot token；辅助正则惩罚slot注意力图重叠并使slot嵌入去相关，降低冗余、促进互补注意力。
AI.result: Simpler-WidowX成功率58.7%→69.8%（+11.1pp）；LIBERO 97.2%；真实世界任务52.8%；记忆依赖的RMBench 21.6%。
AI.conclusion: 有界近期视觉证据的选择性压缩对动作解码有效，但更难的多观测任务暴露有限历史窗口的局限；为历史利用提供了轻量、可插拔的解码端方案。

title: OmniGround: Strengthening Omni-Modal Temporal Grounding via Attention-Consistency Training
summary: Omni-modal large language models can jointly understand video, audio, and text, yet they remain weak at temporal grounding, a capability essential for real-world audio-visual applications. To understand this limitation, we look beyond final predictions and examine the model's internal temporal evidence. We identify a temporal generation gap: the internal attention of the model localizes the target moment more accurately than the timestamps it generates. To close this gap, we propose TACG (Temporal Attention-Consistency Grounding), a post-training method that treats internal attention as a reliable temporal pivot and aligns it with both the model prediction and the ground-truth annotation through attention-consistency training. We further build a 580K-sample training dataset by reconstructing temporal QA from dense audio-visual annotations and organizing general omni-modal instruction data. Using TACG and this training dataset, we train OmniGround, a general-purpose omni-modal model with stronger temporal grounding capability, without injecting any additional temporal cues. OmniGround reaches state-of-the-art omni-modal temporal grounding, including 37.5 mIoU on LongVALE and 35.7 mIoU on UnAV-100, while staying competitive on both general audio-visual understanding and vision-only grounding.

AI.tldr: 发现全模态大模型存在"时序生成鸿沟"：内部注意力定位目标时刻比生成的时间戳更准，提出TACG注意力一致性后训练方法对齐注意力与预测/真值，训练出OmniGround模型。
AI.motivation: 全模态大模型虽能联合理解视频、音频、文本，但时序定位（temporal grounding）能力薄弱，而这是真实音视频应用的核心能力。作者希望不止看最终预测，而是从模型内部时序证据出发理解该缺陷成因。
AI.method: 先诊断出"时序生成鸿沟"：模型内部注意力对目标时刻的定位精度高于其生成的文本时间戳。据此提出TACG（Temporal Attention-Consistency Grounding）后训练方法，把内部注意力视为可靠的时序枢轴（pivot），通过注意力一致性训练将其同时对齐到模型预测与真值标注。并构建58万样本训练集：从稠密音视频标注重建时序QA，配合通用全模态指令数据。
AI.result: 在不注入额外时序线索的前提下训练出OmniGround，在LongVALE上达到37.5 mIoU、UnAV-100上35.7 mIoU，取得SOTA全模态时序定位结果，同时在通用音视频理解与纯视觉grounding上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 内部注意力可作为比生成时间戳更可靠的定位信号；通过注意力一致性后训练可有效闭合时序生成鸿沟，提升全模态时序定位且不损害通用能力。

title: Policy Search in Code Space for Multi-Agent Pathfinding
summary: Developing coordination policies for complex multi-agent systems relies on either labor-intensive algorithm design or opaque task-specific reinforcement learning. With recent advances in autonomous coding agents, we show that policy search directly in code space offers a compelling third path that combines automated optimization with explicit interpretability. We investigate a human-directed workflow in which coding agents iteratively propose, implement, evaluate, diagnose, and eventually refine algorithms guided by simulation feedback and explicit correctness verification. We conducted two case studies and found that this workflow robustly outperformed any manually engineered solutions. On a challenging map in the 2024 League of Robot Runners competition, a two-day search discovered a policy that exceeds the stronger locally reproduced competition entry by 35.0% on the densest instance and generalizes to unseen map instances. In simulated real-world warehouses with irregular lanes, continuous robot geometry, and asynchronous motion, a week-long search discovered an entirely new class of multi-agent pathfinding algorithm that outperforms a calibrated proprietary solution in throughput by 58.9%. Under stated assumptions, we further prove that the new algorithm is collision-free and completes, in finite time, every accepted goal that is not withdrawn or replaced. Together, the studies show that policy search in code space powered by state-of-the-art coding agents offers a highly competitive path to building real engineering solutions that are both effective and analytically tractable.

AI.tldr: 用编码智能体在代码空间做多智能体协调策略搜索（提出-实现-评估-诊断-精炼闭环），在Robot Runners地图上较复现的强基线提升35.0%，在模拟真实仓库中发现新MAPF算法，吞吐量较商业方案提升58.9%，并给出无碰撞与有限时间完成的证明。
AI.motivation: 多智能体协调策略的传统两条路径各有缺陷：人工算法设计成本高，任务特定的强化学习不可解释。作者希望探索第三条路径——直接在代码空间搜索策略，兼得自动化优化与显式可解释性，并验证自主编码智能体能否作为策略搜索引擎产出工程可用且可分析的算法。
AI.method: 提出有人类引导的编码智能体工作流：智能体迭代地提出、实现、评估、诊断并精炼算法，以仿真反馈与显式正确性校验为信号。开展两组案例研究：(1) 2024 League of Robot Runners 的困难地图（两天搜索）；(2) 含不规则通道、连续几何与异步运动的模拟真实仓库（一周搜索）。同时对所得新算法给出无碰撞与有限时间完成的形式化证明。
AI.result: 在Robot Runners最稠密实例上超越本地复现的更强参赛方案35.0%，且可泛化到未见地图实例；在模拟仓库场景中发现一类全新MAPF算法，吞吐量较经标定的专有方案高58.9%，并在给定假设下证明其无碰撞且对未被撤回/替换的目标均在有限时间内完成。
AI.conclusion: 由先进编码智能体驱动的代码空间策略搜索是一种极具竞争力的建模范式，能产出既有效又可解析论证的工程解，为复杂多智能体系统提供自动化且可解释的第三条路径。

title: HORIA: 4D Human and Object Reconstruction from a Monocular Video with Interaction-Aware Re-Rendering
summary: Joint 4D reconstruction of a human and object from a monocular video is essential for understanding how people interact with their environment. While recent methods have made noticeable progress, capturing such human-object interactions remains difficult due to two main challenges. First, a video typically contains composite semantic context spanning multiple interaction phases, making it difficult to track the temporal changes of the interaction in the reconstruction. Second, under human-object occlusion, a single-view observation contains incomplete visual information about the interaction, resulting in geometrically inconsistent reconstructions. To address these challenges, we introduce HORIA, built upon two core designs. First, we decompose the entire input video into temporally grounded and semantically distinct interaction phases with motion-aware captioning, obtaining a specific text description for each phase. Second, conditioned on these text descriptions of the interaction, we propose an interaction-aware re-rendering that compensates for the limited single-view observation. Specifically, we render the initially reconstructed 4D human and object from novel viewpoints and refine the renderings with a text-to-video diffusion prior, which provides auxiliary novel-view supervision beyond single-view cues. As a result, our framework produces temporally coherent and accurate 4D reconstructions under diverse interaction scenarios, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: HORIA通过"运动感知字幕分解交互阶段"+"文本-视频扩散先验的交互感知重渲染"实现单目视频中人与物体的联合4D重建，在遮挡条件下获得时序一致且几何准确的SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 单目视频人-物交互4D重建有两大难点：(1) 视频含跨多个交互阶段的复合语义上下文，难以刻画交互的时序变化；(2) 人-物相互遮挡下单视图信息不完整，导致重建几何不一致。
AI.method: 两个核心设计：(1) 用motion-aware captioning把整段视频分解为时间定位且语义区分的交互阶段，为每个阶段得到专属文本描述；(2) 以这些交互文本为条件，提出interaction-aware re-rendering：将初步重建的4D人体与物体从新视角渲染，再用text-to-video扩散先验精化渲染结果，提供超出单视图线索的新视角辅助监督。
AI.result: 在多种交互场景下生成时序连贯、几何准确的4D重建，达到state-of-the-art性能（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: 将阶段化语义描述与生成式扩散先验引入新视角渲染监督，是缓解单目遮挡下几何歧义的有效范式，为人-物交互4D重建提供可扩展方案。

title: PaceVLA: Adaptive Temporal Action Quantization in Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Fast and reliable manipulation is crucial for practical robot deployment. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown remarkable progress as generalist robot policies, their execution often remains temporally inefficient. A key source of this inefficiency is that policies learn fine-grained temporal patterns from teleoperated demonstrations, requiring many low-level action steps. Temporal action quantization offers a simple way to accelerate execution by aggregating consecutive low-level actions into temporally coarser actions. However, applying action quantization without considering when fine-grained control is required introduces a speed-accuracy trade-off: accelerated actions may efficiently reduce redundant steps in some phases, while discarding critical motion details in precision-sensitive interactions. To address this, we propose PaceVLA, a unified framework for adaptive temporal execution in VLAs that integrates two coupled components: (1) mode-specific action decoders built on a shared action expert, supporting multiple temporal granularities and prediction horizons, and (2) a quantizability-guided mode selection scheme which decides whether coarse execution is appropriate, and a context-conditioned router that selects an execution mode at each inference step. Experiments across three multi-task simulation benchmarks and six real-world tasks show that PaceVLA improves execution efficiency while maintaining task success rate across multiple embodiments, including long-horizon and dexterous manipulation.

AI.tldr: PaceVLA：在共享 action expert 上挂载多粒度/prediction horizon 的 action decoder，配合可量化性引导的模式选择与上下文条件路由，按推理步自适应选择时间粒度，加速 VLA 执行。
AI.motivation: VLA 从遥操演示中学到细粒度时间模式，需大量低层动作步，执行 temporally inefficient；简单 temporal action quantization 加速会引入速度-精度权衡（精度敏感阶段丢失关键运动细节）。
AI.method: 统一自适应时间执行框架，含两个耦合组件：(1) 基于共享 action expert 的 mode-specific 解耦 action decoder，支持多时间粒度与多预测时域；(2) quantizability-guided 模式选择（判断粗粒度是否合适）＋ context-conditioned router 逐步选择执行模式。
AI.result: 3 个多任务仿真 benchmark 与 6 个真实世界任务上，跨多种 embodiments（含长程与灵巧操作）在保持成功率的同时提升执行效率。
AI.conclusion: 自适应时间粒度可缓解 VLA 的速度-精度权衡，是提升实际部署效率的有效手段。

title: SkateNav: Learning Energy-Efficient Navigation through Adaptive Skating on Passive-Wheel Quadrupedal Robots
comment: 8 pages, 12 figures, 3 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Passive-wheel quadrupedal robots offer energy-efficient locomotion through leg-driven propulsion and momentum-driven gliding. However, navigation requires coordinating steering with intermittent propulsion and adapting push-glide timing to task demands. Velocity-tracking objectives may suppress the speed variations inherent in skating, discouraging efficient gliding. To address these challenges, we propose SkateNav, a unified skating-navigation framework based on reinforcement learning. A time-budgeted goal-reaching objective allows the policy to jointly learn steering, propulsion, and their temporal allocation. An adaptive skating cycle structures gliding, pushing, and recovery, while frequency modulation at every control step adjusts phase durations to navigation demands. Simulation experiments demonstrate higher average success rates and lower cost of transport than the evaluated planner-controller baselines, with ablations confirming the contributions of cycle structure and frequency adaptation. Real-world experiments demonstrate zero-shot transfer from simulation to a passive-wheel Mini Cheetah across cluttered indoor spaces, slopes, and paved outdoor surfaces. Supplementary videos are available on the project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出 SkateNav，一个基于强化学习的统一滑行导航框架：用时间预算型到达目标联合学习转向、推进与时间分配，配合自适应滑行周期与逐步频率调制，在被动轮四足机器人上实现高效滑行导航并完成仿真到真机的零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 被动轮四足机器人靠"腿部推进+惯性滑行"实现高能效运动，但导航需要把转向与间歇推进协同起来，并按任务需求调整"推-滑"时序；传统速度跟踪目标会压抑滑行固有的速度起伏，反而损害滑行能效。
AI.method: 强化学习框架：(1) 时间预算型目标到达奖励，使策略联合学习转向、推进及二者的时间分配，避免速度跟踪约束；(2) 自适应滑行周期，将结构化的滑行、推进、恢复相整合；(3) 每个控制步进行频率调制，按导航需求调整相位时长。
AI.result: 仿真中平均成功率高于所比较的规划器-控制器基线，运输成本更低；消融实验验证了周期结构与频率自适应两项设计的贡献。真机实验在被动轮 Mini Cheetah 上实现零样本迁移，覆盖杂乱室内空间、坡道与铺装室外路面。
AI.conclusion: 将导航目标从速度跟踪改为时间预算达成，并把滑行周期结构与频率自适应纳入学习，可同时获得高任务成功率与低运输成本，且策略可从仿真零样本迁移至真实被动轮四足平台。

title: Token-Set Choice Confounds POPE: A Systematic Audit of Yes/No Extraction in VLM Hallucination Evaluation
comment: Accepted at the VLM4RWD workshop, NeurIPS 2026 (poster). 21 pages, 10 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: We set out to reproduce a recent hallucination-mitigation result on the POPE benchmark. The LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline we measured, 82.21 F1 on the adversarial split, sat 1.21 to 8.67 points above the adversarial baselines we planned to compare against (81.00, 79.30, and 73.54). We looked at the evaluation code and found a readout choice that moves F1 on its own. A two-token logit readout decides yes versus no by comparing two vocabulary IDs, 3582 ("yes") and 1217 ("no"). Across 9,000 greedy-decode questions spanning all three splits, neither ID is generated even once. The model emits " Yes" (token 3869) and " No" (token 1939), because SentencePiece prepends a space byte after the prompt suffix "ASSISTANT:". Read with an eight-token lookup that covers the space-prefixed surface forms, LLaVA-1.5-7B scores F1 0.8221, 0.8498, and 0.8713 on the adversarial, popular, and random splits. That 6.13-point adversarial shift exceeds the adversarial gain reported by five of the six papers we surveyed. None of them states its readout, and our reference ran under 4-bit NF4 quantization, so we cannot say how much of any reported gain a matched evaluation would keep. That comparison stays unresolved until readout and precision are matched. On the fixed baseline we run nine inference-time corrections of our own (none beat it) and dissect why the adversarial split resists logit-level intervention. In a 3,000-question probe, wrong predictions draw more image attention than correct ones (Cohen's $d=-0.46$, $p=1.4\times10^{-24}$), the opposite of what grounding-based corrections assume. A four-readout audit across four further VLMs from three tokenizer families confirms the confound is protocol-level, not model-specific: porting the LLaVA-1.5 IDs verbatim drops F1 to 0.00 on the two disjoint-vocabulary models, whereas a tokenizer-derived readout holds between 0.80 and 0.92.

AI.tldr: 本文复现POP Er幻觉缓解结果时发现，F1差异主要源于yes/no的logit读出协议差异（token id 3582/1217 vs 实际生成的" Yes"/" No"，3869/1939），统一读出后LLaVA-1.5-7B对抗split F1为0.8221，单此一项带来6.13点偏移，超过6篇文献中5篇报告的"对抗增益"；4-bit NF4量化进一步使比较不可比。作者另提9种推理时修正均无效，并探明对抗split中错误预测反而获得更多图像注意力（d=-0.46），与grounding类修正假设相反；跨4个VLM、3个tokenizer家族验证该混淆是协议级问题。
AI.motivation: 现有POPE等幻觉基准上的"方法增益"可能被评估协议（token读出方式、量化精度）混淆，导致误导性的对比与不可复现的结论；作者希望在匹配读出与精度的前提下检验基线是否真的被超越，并诊断对抗split难修正的机理。
AI.method: (1) 复现LLaVA-1.5-7B在POPE三split上的结果，检查评估代码，对比两token（3582"yes"/1217"no"）与八token覆盖率更高的读出方式，并用9000题greedy解码统计实际生成token；(2) 在固定基线（4-bit NF4量化）上尝试9种推理时修正（logit级干预）；(3) 3000题探针做注意力归因分析（Cohen's d检验正确/错误预测的图像注意力差异）；(4) 在另外4个VLM、跨3个tokenizer家族上做四读出审计，含逐字移植ID与tokenizer派生读出的对比。
AI.result: 两token读出下基线82.21 F1（对抗split），比三个对照基线（81.00/79.30/73.54）高1.21~8.67点；但9000题中3582/1217从未被生成，模型实际输出" Yes"(3869)与" No"(1939)。八token读出后三split F1为0.8221/0.8498/0.8713。9种推理时修正均未超越固定基线。注意力探针：错误预测获得更多图像注意力（d=-0.46, p=1.4e-24）。跨模型审计：逐字移植ID在两个不共享词表的模型上F1跌至0.00，tokenizer派生读出维持在0.80~0.92。
AI.conclusion: POPE上报告的幻觉缓解增益在很大程度上可由读出协议与量化精度差异解释，匹配协议前无法判定方法优劣；该混淆是协议级、跨模型跨tokenizer普遍存在，grounding类推理时修正的假设在对抗split上不成立。建议基准强制报告读出方式与数值精度。

title: Reconstruction and Discrete-Event Simulation Assessment of an Analytical
summary: This article presents an analytical-DES benchmark for intra-aisle robotic picking in automated warehousing. The investigated cycle combines horizontal shuttle travel, tote handling and item picking at storage locations. Simulation results are compared with the analytical formulation of Lerher et al. under the same rack geometry, shuttle-motion, handling and picking conditions, and the same definitions of cycle time and derived item throughput. Reproducing the published analytical tables requires the distance interpretation dES = 1.5 m and dTB = 0 m. The analytical-DES benchmark comprises 180 scenarios formed from three rack lengths, two paired motion profiles and n = 1 to 30 visited picking locations, with ten simulation replications per scenario. The six n = 1 cases are reported separately because no travel-between component is present. Across the remaining 174 scenarios, the mean absolute relative cycle-time discrepancy is 0.8655%, the median is 0.6758%, and the maximum is 7.0370%. The mean absolute error is 2.411 s and the RMSE is 2.744 s. The simulated scenario-mean cycle time is below the analytical value in all 174 principal scenarios. The results therefore show close numerical correspondence under the tested conditions, but not exact agreement, formal statistical equivalence, or validation against an operating warehouse.

AI.tldr: 该文构建“解析模型-DES”基准，对比仓库巷道内机器人拣选循环时间的解析公式与仿真结果，180场景中174个的平均相对偏差0.87%、最大7.04%，结论为数值接近但非精确一致、未做真实仓库验证。
AI.motivation: 自动化仓库巷道内机器人拣选（穿梭车移动+料箱处理+货位拣选）的行车时间解析公式（Lerher等）缺乏系统性的仿真对照验证，且已有解析表复现依赖未明确说明的距离参数取值，需要建立可复现的解析-DES对照基准。
AI.method: 固定货架几何、穿梭车运动、装卸与拣选条件及循环时间/吞吐量定义，先通过反推确定复现原文解析表所需距离解释（dES=1.5 m、dTB=0 m）；随后构造180场景（3种巷道长度×2种配对运动曲线×n=1~30个拣选货位），每场景10次仿真重复，n=1的6个无“货位间移动”分量的场景单独报告，其余174场景与解析式逐项对比，统计相对偏差、MAE、RMSE及偏差符号。
AI.result: 174个主场景中，循环时间平均绝对相对偏差0.8655%、中位数0.6758%、最大7.0370%；MAE=2.411 s，RMSE=2.744 s；所有174个场景的仿真均值均低于解析值（系统性偏保守）。
AI.conclusion: 在测试条件下解析模型与DES数值高度接近但非完全一致，不构成形式统计等价性，也未对运行中的真实仓库做验证；解析式可用于早期设计与产能估算，但需注意其偏乐观的循环时间估计及未公开的距离参数敏感性。

title: On the Benefits of Uncertainty Estimation for Species Classification: A Case Study on Optimizing Expert re-Annotation
summary: Automated identification of diatoms from microscopic images is a cornerstone of large-scale freshwater biomonitoring, yet the high diversity of species and strong class imbalance pose significant challenges for reliable classification. In this study, we develop a ResNet-18 baseline for a 759-class diatom dataset and investigate how calibrated confidence estimates support selective classification to reduce expert workload without sacrificing taxonomic integrity. While the initial model exhibits overconfidence with an Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of 0.117, post-hoc temperature scaling (T = 2.12) dramatically improves reliability, lowering the ECE to this http URL leveraging these calibrated probabilities within a triage framework, we demonstrate that a Selective Macro-F1 score of 99.01% can be maintained at 66.2% coverage (rejection threshold $\tau$ = 0.934). Qualitative analysis reveals that the system effectively functions as an intelligent filter, consistently deferring rare taxa-such as AAMB and AASI-and ambiguous morphologies for expert review. Our findings, supported by the torch-uncertainty framework, highlight the potential of simple calibration techniques to make automated diatom identification practical and robust, prioritizing the preservation of rare species metrics essential for ecological assessment. To support reproducibility, our code, environment specifications, and calibration results are available anonymously at https://anonymous.4open. science/r/greenprwksp-B53D/README.

AI.tldr: ResNet-18基线在759类硅藻显微图像数据集上结合温度缩放校准，用选择性分类（拒识）构建专家复核分流框架。
AI.motivation: 硅藻自动识别是淡水生物监测的基础，但物种多样性高、类别严重不平衡，且模型过度自信，导致难以在保证分类学完整性的前提下减少专家工作量。
AI.method: ResNet-18 多类基线；用 ECE 评估置信度校准；后验温度缩放（T=2.12）；在校准概率上设定拒识阈值 τ=0.934 实现选择性分类，并用 torch-uncertainty 框架复现。
AI.result: 初始模型 ECE=0.117（过自信），温度缩放后 ECE 大幅下降；在 66.2% 覆盖率下仍保持 99.01% 的 Selective Macro-F1；定性上系统优先推迟稀有类群（如 AAMB、AASI）与形态模糊样本给专家。
AI.conclusion: 简单的后验校准即可显著提升置信度可靠性，配合选择性分类可让自动硅藻鉴定实用且稳健，同时优先保护稀有物种的评估指标。

title: FR-VLA: Implicit Force Reasoning VLA for Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: Integrating force awareness into Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models involves not merely encoding wrench measurements as an additional modality, but determining when and how strongly physical interaction should influence robot action generation. Existing VLAs that use force typically inject it through a fixed pathway, without explicitly determining when it is relevant to the current action. This calls for an intermediate force relevance mechanism inside the VLA, in which visual-language context estimates the relevance of physical feedback to the current task before force enters the action pathway. FR-VLA addresses this gap with a Vision-Language Force-Reasoning Model that uses learnable force query tokens to derive a force admission signal grounded in visual-language context, and uses this signal to modulate an external tokenized force pathway for action generation. In real-world experiments on five contact-rich tasks across two robotic platforms, FR-VLA achieves the highest mean success rate over six evaluated stages, and trajectory visualizations show that its force admission varies with the interaction phase.

AI.tldr: FR-VLA 用可学习的 force query token 从视觉-语言上下文估计"力是否相关"，生成 force admission 信号来门控外部 tokenized 力通路，从而决定何时、以多强程度让力反馈参与动作生成。
AI.motivation: 现有融入力觉的 VLA 多通过固定通路注入 wrench 测量，未显式判断力在当 前动作中是否相关；论文主张力觉接入需要一个"中间相关性机制"，由视觉-语言上下文先行判定物理反馈的任务相关性。
AI.method: 在两平台五个接触密集任务上做真机实验，对比六个评估阶段，并可视化 force admission 随交互阶段的变化。
AI.result: FR-VLA 在六个评估阶段取得最高平均成功率；轨迹可视化显示其 force admission 随交互阶段变化，说明门控学到了阶段性物理相关性。
AI.conclusion: 力觉的有效融合关键在于相关性与强度的门控，而非简单叠加模态；学习式 admission 信号为力感知 VLA 提供了可解释且有效的接入方式。

title: Self-Supervised Inertial Odometry
summary: Learning inertial odometry for a new platform usually requires ground-truth trajectories. We show that an inertial odometry model can instead be trained from scratch by a myopic teacher that integrates the IMU over each short window independently, a scheme we call integration this http URL , although supervised only by short-window velocity changes, the student learns to directly predict velocity, and does so more accurately than its integration teacher. Pose graph distillation then refines the model with sequence-consistent targets from a pose graph over many windows. Training on a new platform therefore no longer requires collecting ground-truth trajectories, but only calibrating the IMU and recording data during normal operation. Across six datasets spanning pedestrians, drones, quadrupeds, and a humanoid, the same recipe with no velocity or position labels trains models that come within $0.07$~m/s average velocity error of a same-architecture supervised baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出"Integration-Then-Distillation"两阶段方案：先用短窗口分别积分IMU得到"近视教师"监督，让学生网络直接预测速度；再用多窗口位姿图蒸馏出序列一致目标。无需真值轨迹即可从零训练惯性里程计，六个数据集上平均速度误差仅比同架构监督基线高0.07 m/s。
AI.motivation: 惯性里程计（IO）模型通常依赖真值轨迹做监督，而新平台采集真值轨迹成本高、需动捕或外置定位。作者希望摆脱真值标注，使新平台只需标定IMU并在正常操作中录数据即可训练模型。
AI.method: 两阶段自监督蒸馏：①在每个短窗口内独立积分IMU，得到窗口级速度变化量作为"近视教师"监督学生直接预测速度（学生因避免积分漂移而优于教师）；②在多个窗口上构建位姿图，以序列一致目标对学生做位姿图蒸馏，恢复长时一致性。全程不使用速度或位置标签。
AI.result: 在行人、无人机、四足、人形等六个数据集上，同一流程从头训练、无速度/位置标签，平均速度误差与同架构全监督基线相差仅0.07 m/s。
AI.conclusion: 短窗口积分监督+位姿图蒸馏可替代真值轨迹监督，实现跨平台零真值惯性里程计训练，显著降低新平台部署的数据采集门槛。

title: TempoMoE: Identifying and Steering Fast-Slow Thinking Experts for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reasoning models rely on long chain-of-thought (CoT) for complex tasks, yet often overthink easy inputs, increasing token cost and latency, and sometimes degrading accuracy. Existing methods optimize reasoning length during training or impose external control at inference, but leave the underlying reasoning mechanism a black box. We find that fast and slow thinking exhibit distinct expert-routing patterns: holding the input fixed and varying only the prompted reasoning tempo produces stable routing shifts. Suppressing slow-thinking experts shortens the reasoning chain, whereas suppressing fast-thinking experts lengthens it, providing causal evidence that these experts influence reasoning depth. Based on this finding, we propose TempoMoE, a training-free, two-stage framework. It identifies fast- and slow-thinking experts via tempo-contrastive routing analysis and redistributes routing weights within the original top-k set according to sample difficulty. It amplifies fast-thinking experts and suppresses slow-thinking experts on easy inputs and reverses this adjustment on hard ones, enabling difficulty-adaptive control over reasoning depth. We evaluate TempoMoE on Kimi-VL, Qwen3-VL, and ERNIE-4.5-VL across six benchmarks. Compared with Vanilla, TempoMoE consistently improves accuracy while reducing output tokens, with accuracy gains of up to 2.6 points and token reductions of up to 35.4%.

AI.tldr: 提出TempoMoE：无需训练的两阶段框架，通过"节奏对比"路由分析识别多模态MoE模型中的快/慢思考专家，并按样本难度在原top-k内重分配路由权重，实现难度自适应的推理深度控制。
AI.motivation: 多模态MoE推理模型依赖长CoT处理复杂任务，但对简单输入常过度思考，导致token开销与延迟上升、准确率下降。现有方法或在训练期优化长度、或在推理期外挂控制，均未触及内部推理机制（黑箱）。作者希望从专家路由层面揭示并直接操控推理深度。
AI.method: 关键发现：固定输入、仅改变提示的推理节奏，可产生稳定的专家路由偏移；抑制慢思考专家缩短推理链、抑制快思考专家则延长推理链，构成因果证据。据此设计TempoMoE：阶段一用tempo-contrastive路由分析识别快/慢思考专家；阶段二在原始top-k集合内按样本难度重分配路由权重——简单输入放大快思考专家、压制慢思考专家，困难输入反向调整。
AI.result: 在Kimi-VL、Qwen3-VL、ERNIE-4.5-VL三个模型、六个基准上评测：相对Vanilla均提升准确率并减少输出token，准确率最高提升2.6分，token最多减少35.4%。
AI.conclusion: 快/慢思考行为在MoE中可由专家路由稳定刻画并因果操控；仅在top-k内重加权即可训练-free地实现难度自适应推理深度控制，兼顾精度与效率，无需改动模型参数。

title: Curvature as a Baseline: Monocular Pose Measurement of Cylindrical Objects with Dual Colour Stripe Markers
summary: Thin cylindrical objects offer little space for planar markers. We propose a dual-colour-stripe marker that uses the known curvature of an object to improve pose measurement with a single camera. The boundary between two colours provides a long centre line, while dots and printed edges supply features at different depths. We analyse how this depth separation improves the estimation of rotation about the cylinder axis, or roll. For a camera-facing marker at 15 cm, the Cramér-Rao lower bound on roll standard deviation is 2.00°for a flat marker, 0.38°for a single curved marker and 0.21°for a wrap-around marker. Monte Carlo roll RMS errors are within about 10% of the corresponding standard-deviation bounds. A first-order relation connects the sagitta of the curved marker to the roll sensitivity provided by a stereo baseline. The analytical and simulation results explain how curvature improves monocular measurement and provide a basis for designing marker geometry.

AI.tldr: 提出双色条纹圆柱标记，利用已知曲率以单目相机提升位姿测量，尤其改善绕轴滚转角的估计精度。
AI.motivation: 细圆柱体表面难以布置平面标记，导致单目视觉下的六自由度位姿（特别是滚转角）估计精度低。
AI.method: 设计双色条纹标记：两色边界提供长中心线，圆点与印刷边缘提供不同深度的特征；结合物体已知曲率建立深度分离模型，用Cramér-Rao下界分析滚转角精度，并推导曲率矢高与等效立体基线的一阶关系，辅以蒙特卡洛仿真验证。
AI.result: 在15 cm处正对相机时，滚转角标准差CRLB为：平面标记2.00°、单曲面标记0.38°、环绕标记0.21°；蒙特卡洛滚转RMS误差与理论下界偏差约10%以内。
AI.conclusion: 解析与仿真结果表明曲率可显著提升单目滚转角测量精度，可用于指导标记几何设计；但属特定标定/追踪量测方案，缺乏机器人闭环实验。

title: FrameGRPO: Incentivizing Video Reasoning via Multi-Frame Rollouts and Temporal Credit
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has improved video reasoning in multimodal large language models. However, standard video GRPO varies only linguistic trajectories while conditioning every rollout in a group on the same sampled frames, which can produce homogeneous rewards and weaken group-relative learning when the shared visual evidence is insufficient or distracting. We propose \textbf{FrameGRPO}, a simple and effective reinforcement-learning framework that requires neither auxiliary networks nor changes to the model architecture. Specifically, FrameGRPO combines two lightweight components: (1) \textbf{Multi-Frame Rollouts}, which use only uniform temporal subsampling of a single maximal-frame decode to construct aligned views that diversify visual evidence and reasoning trajectories; and (2) \textbf{Gated Temporal Efficiency Credit}, which selectively reinforces a correct lower-ratio trajectory when all rollouts in a fixed full-ratio reference subset fail, without imposing an unconditional preference for fewer frames. Extensive experiments across diverse video understanding and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate robust overall improvements over standard GRPO, highlighting temporal-view diversification as an effective mechanism for exploration and credit assignment in video MLLMs.

AI.tldr: FrameGRPO：通过多帧rollout与门控时序效率信用改进视频MLLM的GRPO式RLVR，无需辅助网络或架构改动。
AI.motivation: 标准视频GRPO只变化语言轨迹，同一组内所有rollout共享同一组采样帧，导致视觉证据单一、奖励同质化，削弱组相对优势信号。
AI.method: 两个轻量组件：(1) Multi-Frame Rollouts——对单次最大帧数解码做均匀时间下采样，构造对齐的多视角，以多样化视觉证据与推理轨迹；(2) Gated Temporal Efficiency Credit——仅当固定全帧参考子集全部失败时，才对正确的低帧比轨迹给予强化，避免无条件偏好少帧。
AI.result: 在多个视频理解与推理基准上相对标准GRPO取得稳定整体提升，验证了时序视角多样化对探索与信用分配的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 时序视角多样化是视频MLLM强化学习中提升探索与信用分配的简洁有效机制，且易即插即用。

title: TamedFlow: Trajectory-Aware Distillation\\for Teacher-Assisted Diffusion Sampling
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) deliver high-fidelity image and video generation, but inference requires many sequential model evaluations. Two acceleration strategies are increasingly important: model compression makes each evaluation cheaper, while adaptive inference avoids selected teacher computation through reuse, forecasting, or speculative execution. Their combination, however, is brittle: directly applying the evaluated adaptive methods to a compressed student can degrade quality, an observed failure mode we call the \textbf{Combination Gap}. We link this gap to a mismatch between pointwise distillation and short-horizon execution: a student trained at teacher states need not remain reliable when its own predictions are chained. We propose \textbf{TamedFlow}, which trains a compressed DiT for this deployed role through cross-architecture feature alignment, a near-identity Velocity Alignment Head, and randomized rollout supervision. At inference, a lightweight Learnable Trajectory Estimator routes completed drafts: accepted drafts bypass the teacher, while rejected drafts roll back and receive one teacher rescue step. Distilling DiT-XL/2 into DiT-B/2, TamedFlow reaches FID $2.58$ at $2.25\times$ measured speedup over DDIM-50 on ImageNet $256\times256$. Ablations support trajectory supervision, and routing controls favor LTE over random decisions at nearly matched latency. Evaluations on ImageNet $512\times512$, MS-COCO, and Latte/FaceForensics extend the empirical scope.

AI.tldr: TamedFlow将压缩DiT与自适应推理联合训练以消除"组合鸿沟"，通过跨架构特征对齐、近恒等速度对齐头、随机rollout监督训练学生模型，推理时用轻量可学习轨迹估计器路由草稿，配合教师救援步，在ImageNet 256×256上以2.25×加速达到FID 2.58。
AI.motivation: DiT推理需大量串行评估，压缩（降低单步成本）与自适应推理（跳过部分教师计算）各自有效，但直接组合会显著掉点，作者称之为"Combination Gap"。根因被归为逐点蒸馏与短时域执行的不匹配：学生在教师状态上训练，却在自身预测链式执行时不可靠。
AI.method: 训练侧：跨架构特征对齐（DiT-XL/2→DiT-B/2）、近恒等Velocity Alignment Head、随机rollout监督使学生适应自身累积误差。推理侧：可学习轨迹估计器（LTE）对草稿进行路由，接受的草稿绕过教师，被拒绝的草稿回滚并执行一次教师救援步。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256上FID 2.58，相对DDIM-50实测2.25×加速；消融验证轨迹监督的必要性，LTE路由在近乎相同延迟下优于随机路由。并在ImageNet 512×512、MS-COCO、Latte/FaceForensics上扩展验证。
AI.conclusion: 压缩与自适应推理的组合需在训练阶段显式面向"自回归式部署角色"建模，随机rollout监督加草稿路由可有效弥合组合鸿沟，实现高质量高加速的DiT采样。

title: After the Federation: Benchmarking Knowledge Portability to Heterogeneous Newcomers
summary: Once historical clients become unavailable, a federation must serve newcomers through the artifact it leaves behind. How much of its knowledge remains useful in an architecture chosen afterward? We introduce FEDNBO, a seven-dataset benchmark that separates knowledge supply, policy identification, and private-model compilation under disjoint data roles. Controlled studies expose inflated oracle gains, architecture-dependent transfer reversals, and a gap between teacher accuracy and private-model utility. Ordinary public-response distillation provides a competitive reference without public task labels or newcomer samples: gains over strengthened local training are 23.52 and 16.62 percentage points on 300 CelebA identities and 300 FedEMNIST writers, respectively. In a complete-pipeline FedEMNIST comparison, this reference reaches 97.13% accuracy with 12.4 seconds of compilation per architecture, versus 97.03% and 67.5 seconds for a HeteroFedTTA reconstruction at the same epoch budget. Equal-count public-input interventions extend support sensitivity to trainable visual backbones. Together, these results establish an auditable benchmark and a strong reference for evaluating the utility, cost and reliability of post-federation knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FEDNBO，一套七数据集基准，将联邦学习后的知识转移拆分为知识供给、策略识别与私有模型编译三个互斥数据角色；发现oracle增益被高估、跨架构迁移出现反转、教师精度与私有模型效用不一致，并以普通公开响应蒸馏作为强基线（CelebA/FedEMNIST分别提升23.52/16.62个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 历史客户端离线后，联邦产物需服务新加入者；但现有评估混淆了数据角色，缺乏对"后联邦知识转移"效用、成本与可靠性的可审计度量。
AI.method: 构建FEDNBO七数据集基准，以不相交数据角色分离知识供给、策略识别与私有模型编译；设计受控实验检验oracle增益、架构依赖的迁移反转与教师-学生效用差距；对比公开响应蒸馏基线与HeteroFedTTA重建在同epoch预算下的成本与精度。
AI.result: 无公开任务标签与新样本时，公开响应蒸馏在300个CelebA身份与300个FedEMNIST书写者上分别超强化本地训练23.52与16.62个百分点；FedEMNIST全流程中达97.13%精度、每架构编译12.4秒，优于HeteroFedTTA的97.03%/67.5秒；等量公开输入干预可将支持集敏感性扩展至可训练视觉骨干。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供可审计基准与强参考基线，揭示后联邦知识转移中效用评估的陷阱，提示需同时报告效用、成本与可靠性。

title: A Spiking Ring-Attractor Architecture for Representation and Control of Revolute Robot Joints
summary: Robotic systems with revolute joints evolve on circular state spaces, yet most control architectures represent these states using Euclidean variables that ignore this underlying geometry. We propose a fully spiking neural control architecture in which ring attractors encode joint states, enforcing representations consistent with the topology of revolute systems. Homeostatic regulation computes goal-state mismatch directly over these distributed representations, and opponent gain-modulated populations convert this mismatch into controlled phase shifts of the activity bump, implementing set-point regulation as motion on the ring. We show that the bump dynamics follow an SO(2) geometry, and that gain asymmetries induce a signed phase velocity on the ring. To interface distributed activity with scalar regulation signals, we derive an analytic Fourier phase decoder and implement its signed components using push-pull spiking populations. For multi-joint systems, we demonstrate that local ring-based Fourier features compose into product representations that linearly decode SO(3) orientations through forward kinematics. Experiments in NEST validate the full SO(2) regulation mechanism and the spiking product-feature decoder for lift, pitch, and yaw. Robot experiments on a Tiago arm show that decoded ring dynamics generate joint velocity commands, producing directed motion with joint-dependent accuracy. Together, these results establish a neuromorphic control framework in which representation, regulation, and action are unified within a ring-attractor substrate aligned with the geometry of revolute systems.

AI.tldr: 提出全脉冲神经网络控制架构，用环形吸引子编码旋转关节状态，在对数分布表示上做稳态调节并通过Fourier相位解码把分布活动转成标量关节速度指令，实验验证SO(2)调节与SO(3)朝向解码。
AI.motivation: 旋转关节系统的状态空间本质是圆环（SO(2)/SO(3)），但主流控制架构用欧氏变量表示，忽略底层拓扑，导致表示与几何不一致。作者希望在神经形态计算基底上让表示、调节与动作统一到符合旋转几何的环吸引子结构中。
AI.method: 1) 环吸引子活动包编码关节相位，满足SO(2)几何；2) 稳态调节直接在分布式表示上计算目标-状态失配；3) 对立增益调制群体将失配转为有符号相位速度，实现设定点调节；4) 推导解析Fourier相位解码器，用推挽式脉冲群体实现其有符号分量；5) 多关节情形下局部环Fourier特征经前向运动学组合为乘积表示，线性解码SO(3)朝向；6) NEST仿真验证lift/pitch/yaw，Tiago机械臂真实实验把解码的环动力学转为关节速度指令。
AI.result: NEST实验验证了完整SO(2)调节机制与脉冲乘积特征解码器；真实Tiago臂上解码的环动力学生成关节速度指令，产生有方向性的运动，精度依赖关节；给出了增益不对称导致有符号相位速度的理论分析。
AI.conclusion: 建立了以环吸引子为基底、表示-调节-动作统一的神经形态控制框架，使控制表示与旋转关节几何一致；但真实机器人证据为单臂、单任务设定点调节，精度不均，未涉及复杂操作或大规模验证。

title: OmniInteract: Towards Unified Whole-Body Interaction Control for Dual Humanoids
comment: 30 pages including appendix, 11 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Physical interaction is a key capability for humanoid collaboration, requiring coordinated whole-body motion and precise contact. However, learning diverse dual-humanoid interactions faces two major challenges: (1) human-robot morphological differences disrupt contact interfaces and spatial relationships during retargeting, and (2) jointly learning motor skills and partner coordination makes it difficult to retain control fidelity as interaction diversity grows. In this paper, we propose OmniInteract to address these challenges through surface-aware modeling and scalable residual policy learning. First, we introduce Surface Contact-Aware Retargeting, which leverages dense human-robot surface correspondences to jointly retarget both humanoids, preserving explicit interaction contact interfaces and their near-field geometric context. Second, we propose a Scalable Flow-based Interaction Policy for partner-conditioned residual generation. It factorizes dual-humanoid control into a reusable motor foundation and interaction-specific adaptations: partner-aware experts learn corrections over a frozen whole-body motion prior, while conditional flow matching unifies them in a shared residual action space. This enables scalable skill consolidation while retaining pretrained motor capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OmniInteract improves retargeting fidelity and dual-humanoid coordination while better retaining interaction performance as skill diversity grows. Real-world deployment further demonstrates successful contact establishment, stable whole-body coordination, and recovery from external perturbations.

AI.tldr: OmniInteract 提出表面接触感知重定向（Surface Contact-Aware Retargeting）与可扩展流式交互残差策略，实现多样化双人形机器人的全身协调接触交互，并在真机上完成接触建立、稳定性与扰动恢复验证。
AI.motivation: 双人形机器人交互学习面临两大瓶颈：(1) 人-机形态差异在重定向时破坏接触界面与空间关系；(2) 同时学习运动技能与伙伴协同，随交互多样性增加难以保持控制保真度。
AI.method: 1) Surface Contact-Aware Retargeting：利用密集人-机器人表面点对应关系，对两台人形联合重定向，显式保留交互接触界面及其近场几何上下文；2) Scalable Flow-based Interaction Policy：将双人形控制分解为可复用的运动基元与交互特化适配——伙伴感知专家在冻结的全身运动先验上学习残差修正，并用条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）在共享残差动作空间中统一各专家，实现可扩展技能整合而非遗忘预训练运动能力。
AI.result: 实验显示重定向保真度与双人形协同均有提升，且随技能多样性增长更有效地保持交互性能；真机部署成功实现接触建立、稳定的全身协调以及对扰动的恢复。
AI.conclusion: 以"表面接触感知重定向 + 残差流匹配策略"的解耦框架可有效支撑多样化人形交互技能的规模化学习与实机落地，为后续多人/多机交互扩展提供可复用的运动基元接口。

title: AVTime: Reinforcing Dense Audio-Visual Captions with Bidirectional Alignment
summary: Dense temporal audio-visual captioning is important for multimodal video understanding and generation. However, prior work is constrained by three main limitations: (1) the lack of a dataset combining high temporal resolution, longer videos, and bidirectional alignment between time and events; (2) the reliance of most existing RL methods on checklists; and (3) the lack of a benchmark that bidirectionally evaluates event semantic correctness and temporal accuracy. To address these challenges, we propose: (1) AVTime-50K, a high-quality 50K-scale dataset with temporally precise, semantically accurate captions and longer videos; (2) AVTime, a state-of-the-art model optimized with a novel Bidirectional Temporal-Semantic Alignment (BiTSA) reward that imposes explicit bidirectional constraints between time and events; and (3) AVTime-Bench, a specialized benchmark that introduces a novel bidirectional evaluation of temporal accuracy and semantic correctness. Our code, models, and datasets are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 AVTime-50K 数据集、AVTime 模型（BiTSA 双向时序-语义对齐奖励）与 AVTime-Bench 基准，用于稠密时序音视频描述。
AI.motivation: 稠密时序音视频描述对多模态视频理解与生成重要，但现有工作受三点制约：缺少兼具高时序分辨率、长视频与时间-事件双向对齐的数据集；RL 方法多依赖 checklist；缺少同时双向评估语义正确性与时序精度的基准。
AI.method: 构建 50K 规模高质量数据集（时序精确、语义准确、长视频）；用 BiTSA（Bidirectional Temporal-Semantic Alignment）奖励对时间与事件施加显式双向约束来优化模型；设计双向评测基准，同时考核事件语义正确性与时序精度。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标；作者自述 AVTime 为 state-of-the-art，并开源代码、模型与数据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以数据集+模型+基准三位一体方式推动稠密时序音视频描述，核心贡献是双向时序-语义对齐的奖励设计与配套评测协议。

title: Procedural Exposure Bias in Skill-Augmented Language Model Agents
summary: External skills provide language-model agents with reusable procedural knowledge, yet how models use such knowledge after it is supplied remains poorly understood. We identify Procedural Exposure Bias (PEB), the tendency of language models to increasingly favor an action as its associated procedural pattern is repeatedly exposed in a skill, even when the interaction state and action relevance remain unchanged. We find that PEB strongly depends on how procedural knowledge is represented: presenting the same content visually substantially attenuates exposure-induced shifts in action preference relative to textual presentation. Further analysis shows that this attenuation primarily arises from visual encoding rather than structured layout. Although repeated procedural signals remain recoverable from Visual representations, they exert a weaker influence on downstream action prediction, distinguishing signal accessibility from its use as action evidence. This effect also extends to executable action selection, where increasing exposure more strongly favors the corresponding action under Text than Visual. Layer-wise analyses show that exposure-dependent action evidence becomes more pronounced toward the model output, with stronger evidence under Text, while activation interventions reveal architecture-specific roles of internal components in transmitting or counteracting the preference shift. Complete-agent evaluations across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop further show that Visual skills achieve higher macro-average task success than Text skills for all four evaluated models. These findings establish skill representation as an important factor governing how procedural knowledge is translated into agent decisions. All code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 论文提出“程序性暴露偏差”(PEB)：当技能中的程序性模式被重复暴露时，语言模型会越来越偏好对应动作，即使交互状态与动作相关性未变；视觉化表示相比文本化表示能显著削弱该偏差，且完整智能体评测中视觉技能任务成功率更高。
AI.motivation: 外部技能为语言模型智能体提供可复用的程序性知识，但模型在获得这类知识后如何使用它仍缺乏理解。作者希望揭示：技能知识的表示形式（文本 vs 视觉）是否以及如何影响模型把知识转化为动作决策。
AI.method: 首先界定并测量 PEB——在同一技能中反复暴露某一程序性模式后，观测模型动作偏好漂移（保持交互状态与动作相关性不变）。随后做表示形式对照实验：同一内容分别以文本、视觉呈现，并进一步消融视觉编码与结构化版式（layout）的贡献；用探针分析检验重复程序信号在视觉表示中的可恢复性；将实验扩展到可执行动作选择；进行层级分析（随层数接近输出端动作证据增强）与激活干预（区分内部组件在传递/抵消偏好偏移中的作用）；最后在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上对四个模型做完整智能体评测。
AI.result: PEB 强烈依赖程序知识的表示方式：视觉呈现相比文本呈显著减弱由暴露引起的动作偏好偏移；该减弱主要源自视觉编码而非结构化版式；重复程序信号在视觉表示中仍可被恢复，但对下游动作预测影响更弱（区分“信号可获取性”与“作为动作证据的使用”）；可执行动作选择中同样呈现 Text > Visual 的暴露偏置；层级分析显示暴露相关的动作证据随层次接近输出而增强，Text 下更强；激活干预揭示不同内部组件在传递或抵消偏好偏移中具有架构特异性作用；在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop 上，四个被测模型用 Visual 技能均取得高于 Text 技能的宏平均任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 技能表示形式是决定程序性知识能否被转化为智能体决策的关键因素；暴露偏差是技能增强型语言模型智能体的一个系统性风险，视觉化表示是一种有实证支持的缓解路径。

title: Learning the Dose Manifold: A Latent Diffusion Framework for Volumetric Dose Prediction in Automated Radiotherapy Treatment Planning
summary: Automated treatment planning (ATP) aims to reduce the unwarranted inter-planner variability of manual planning, while improving treatment quality and efficiency. Most ATP pipelines rely on the prediction of the achievable three-dimensional dose distribution for a given anatomy and the subsequent optimization of machine parameters to reproduce it. Diffusion-based methods are largely slice-wise due to the high dimensionality of radiotherapy data, and assume a one-to-one mapping between anatomy and optimal dose despite the multi-objective nature of treatment planning. They are evaluated on their ability to match reference doses and rarely on their integration in ATP frameworks. We present LaDose, a latent diffusion framework for fully volumetric dose prediction. An autoencoder learned on dose distributions, trained so that perturbed latents decode to plausible doses, compresses dose maps 128-fold and enables 3D diffusion on a single GPU. Prescription values are represented as exact scalar vectors that bypass the image encoder, avoiding resampling and latent compression. Multiscale classifier-free guidance allows for the modulation of clinical trade-offs at inference, without retraining or additional labeled data. On 900 clinically delivered head-and-neck volumetric modulated arc therapy plans from five centers, LaDose reached a median absolute error of 1.18 Gy (1.4--1.8\% of the prescription) and was the only one of six frameworks free of systematic bias with respect to the reference distribution. Guidance scales acted predictably on target coverage and organ-at-risk sparing. Integrated with direct aperture optimization, the pipeline generated plans in 15.2 minutes; in a blinded review, senior clinicians rated 14 of 15 plans acceptable without editing.

AI.tldr: LaDose：基于自编码器压缩128倍的潜空间扩散框架，实现全三维放疗剂量预测，并通过多尺度无分类器引导在推理时调节临床权衡；结合直接孔径优化，15.2分钟生成头颈VMAT计划，15例中14例经盲审可直接接受。
AI.motivation: 现有自动治疗计划（ATP）中的剂量预测扩散方法多为逐切片处理（受放疗数据高维性限制），且错误假设"解剖—最优剂量"一对一映射，忽略计划的多目标特性；评估多局限于与参考剂量的相似度，鲜有真正嵌入ATP流程的端到端验证。
AI.method: 1）在剂量分布上训练自编码器，并施加扰动潜变量解码为合理剂量的正则，将剂量图压缩128倍，使三维扩散可在单GPU上运行；2）处方值以精确标量向量表示，绕开图像编码器，避免重采样与潜空间压缩带来的精度损失；3）多尺度无分类器引导，推理阶段无需重训或额外标注即可调制临床权衡；4）与直接孔径优化集成构成完整ATP管线。
AI.result: 在五个中心共900例临床头颈VMAT计划上，中位绝对误差1.18 Gy（处方的1.4–1.8%），是六个框架中唯一对参考分布无系统性偏差者；引导尺度对靶区覆盖与危及器官保护的调控符合预期；端到端生成计划耗时15.2分钟，盲审中资深临床医师对15例中的14例无需编辑即判定可接受。
AI.conclusion: 全三维潜扩散剂量预测结合推理时引导，能够在保持几何精度的同时提供可控的多目标权衡，并可与孔径优化串联形成实用ATP管线；但属医学影像/放疗规划领域应用，非具身智能或三维生成核心方向，方法洞见（潜空间压缩+标量条件旁路+多尺度CFG）对外部任务有一定借鉴价值。

title: PhysSkin++: Real-Time and Generalizable Physics-Based Animation via Self-Supervised Neural Skinning
summary: Generalizing real-time physics-based animation across diverse 3D shapes and spatial discretizations remains challenging. In this paper, we introduce PhysSkin++, a physics-informed framework that learns continuous neural skinning fields from static geometries to construct compact deformation subspaces. Specifically, we propose a Neural Skinning Fields Autoencoder that predicts shape-dependent deformation subspaces without per-object network training. To learn these subspaces without simulation trajectories, we develop a Physics-Informed Self-Supervised Learning strategy that combines skinning-field normalization with conflict-aware gradient correction, stabilizing joint optimization under physical and orthogonality constraints. The learned representation supports efficient reduced dynamics with user control and contact interactions, together with direct animation binding to meshes, point clouds, and 3D Gaussians. For prescribed rig animation, we further introduce a self-supervised complementarity objective to learn complementary elastic responses without enforcing complementarity constraints at runtime. Experiments demonstrate cross-shape generalization of the learned skinning fields, real-time reduced simulation, and applications to controllable, collision-aware, and rig-complementary animation.

AI.tldr: PhysSkin++ 用几何自编码器学习连续神经蒙皮场，得到与形状相关的紧凑变形子空间；无需仿真轨迹，靠物理自监督（蒙皮场归一化＋冲突感知梯度修正）训练，支持跨形状实时降阶物理动画，可直接绑定网格、点云与3D高斯。
AI.motivation: 实时物理动画难以泛化到多样3D形状与不同空间离散化；逐物体训练网络代价高，且缺少仿真轨迹作监督信号。
AI.method: Neural Skinning Fields Autoencoder 由静态几何直接预测形状相关变形子空间（免逐物体训练）；物理自监督学习策略结合蒙皮场归一化与冲突感知梯度修正，在物理与正交性约束下稳定联合优化；重定向动画场景引入自监督互补性目标，学习弹性响应而运行时不施加约束。
AI.result: 实验显示蒙皮场具备跨形状泛化，可实现实时降阶仿真，并用于可控、含碰撞及与骨骼动画互补的动画；统一支持网格、点云、3D高斯绑定。
AI.conclusion: 以物理约束下的自监督神经子空间学习替代轨迹监督，为跨形状、跨表示的实时物理动画提供统一且可部署的框架。

title: Risk Decomposition for Hallucination-Aware Video Sampling
summary: Despite achieving high visual fidelity, video models still suffer from physical hallucinations, limiting their reliability as world simulators. Existing methods leverage model-internal or external signals to improve physical plausibility, but their roles and limitations require a unified explanation. We propose a two-dimensional physical-hallucination risk framework that defines low-density sampling risk and high-density drifting risk. The first risk captures generations assigned low likelihood by the video model, for example, a ball suddenly teleporting despite the model favoring continuous motion, while the second risk captures physical inconsistencies in high-likelihood generations, for example, a ball bouncing progressively higher without additional energy. Our analysis explains how model-internal signals steer sampling toward higher-density regions of the learned distribution to address low-density sampling risk. However, higher model likelihood does not guarantee physical plausibility, motivating external guidance to address high-density drifting risk.
